text: I'm really sorry to be messaging at this hour, I know you must be busy. I'm a foster carer and I've got a little boy with me who's 18 months. He's had a temperature since yesterday and it's 39.3 tonight. Earlier he banged his head on the edge of the coffee table, he cried straight away and had a cuddle, and since then he's honestly been completely back to himself, I don't think he's any different at all. I just feel I have to mention it given the temperature as well, and obviously I have to report things properly. His eczema is also flaring up, dry, itchy patches on his arms and behind his knees, he's been scratching. He's still drinking his milk and his water normally, so I don't think that's a problem. I'm not sure if any of this needs looking at tonight or if I'm just being overly cautious. Sorry again, thank you for your time.
